notes: Official Subway Australia nutrition PDF linked from https://www.subway.com/en-au/menunutrition as Nutrition data table [PDF]; PDF title is AUSTRALIA NUTRITION INFORMATION, October 2025.
All calories and protein values are official per-serve values, not calculated from per-100g data. Subway says Footlong sub values are approximately double the Subway 6-Inch sub values.
Subway says nutrition is based on standard recipes and formulations, but values may vary by season, supplier, region, and small product assembly differences.

Vegetarian suitability is inferred from meat-free official item rows plus the official Product Ingredients Guide at https://www.subway.com/en-au/media/australia/documents/nutritionals/aus-ingredient-summary.pdf. The Allergen Guide is at https://www.subway.com/en-au/media/australia/documents/nutritionals/aus-allergens-summary.pdf.
Strict vegetarian trap: Subway warns restaurants use shared equipment and cannot guarantee items are free from contact with other menu items or allergens.
Dairy and egg trap: most higher-protein vegetarian options include cheese, garlic aioli, or egg. Veggie Delite with Avo is lower protein but simpler.
Naming trap: the live menu currently lists Falafel Delight in some places, while the official October 2025 nutrition table uses Smashed Falafel. Rows below use the nutrition-table names.
Selected-location or low-protein extras such as beetroot, avocado, vegetables, sauces, cookies, and smoothies are omitted from add_ons.
